text:
mara: heads up - onboarding harness found mismatched vector dims during rerank smoke tests. sometimes we see 1536 vs 1535.
kevin: repro? is this in prod or just the sampleapp?
mara: sampleapp + our local Node helper. seems correlated with token refresh / auth rotation under load. sequence: token refresh triggers retry path, an item gets requeued and the concatenation/slice logic loses a trailing value.
ryan: do we have the API rejection? paste log.
mara: server log: 
```
[2026-03-03T09:41:00Z] ERROR embeddings.service: batch rejected - vector_length=1535 expected=1536 batch_id=xyz123
```
kevin: that smells like the batching helper splice using `slice(start, end - 1)` when it should be `slice(start, end)`. saw a similar off-by-one when we handled duplicate enqueue on auth retry.
mara: current python sampleapp quietly pads short vectors with zeros which hides the issue from some users. i think that's confusing during onboarding.
ryan: agreed. for DX we should: 1) default to fail-fast on mismatched dims 2) add an explicit `pad_on_shape_mismatch` boolean in samples (default false) so users opt-in.
kevin: SDK parity: Node + Python helpers should both implement a `strictShape=true` default. When true, reject with clear error metadata: expected, got, index. When false, pad/trim and emit a warning log+metric.
ryan: i'll prototype a quick pre-send validator and a unit test that simulates auth refresh while a batch is in-flight. that will catch the requeue duplication path.
mara: temp mitigation for onboarders: run a CI pre-check that asserts vector lengths before calling rerank/embeddings service; if any mismatch, fail early and log which sample id.
kevin: code example for the validator (python):
```py
def validate_vectors(vecs, expected):
    for i, v in enumerate(vecs):
        if len(v) != expected:
            return False, i, len(v)
    return True, None, None
```
ryan: i'll also add a small metric `sdk.embed.invalid_dim` and a tag `sample_app=true|false` so we can spot onboarding noise.
devex-bot: Created DE-1433: "embed helper: strictShape option + auth-requeue fix" (https://git.internal/redwood/issues/DE-1433)
ci-bot: Canary build triggered for devex/helpers with dim-guard patch - build #4822
mara: ran quick smoke - failing path now surfaces a clear 400 with context instead of silent pad. will update onboarding guide + sample README to document strict behavior.
kevin: follow-up: update release notes and include snippet showing how to enable pad-on-mismatch for users who want to accept legacy padded vectors.
mara: thanks all. let's close when CI passes and docs PR is merged.
